title: ElevenLabs Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Ships tailored voice AI solutions end to end with strategic customers: hands-on Python and API integration, plus clear communication with engineers and executives.
source: Built from the published ElevenLabs Forward Deployed Engineer job spec (responsibilities and requirements), 2025–2026 postings.

requirements.why: The role asks for strong Python, software architecture and API integration, and for designing and shipping tailored integrations for customers.
FDEs own delivery end to end for strategic customers and work daily with their engineers and executives to get real value from the technology.
The product is voice and audio AI, and the spec asks for genuine enthusiasm for audio AI and accessibility.
Getting the best out of models is part of building high-quality customer solutions.
The spec asks for first-principles problem solving; customer solutions in high-stakes settings must be reliable.
Enterprise customers expect careful handling of their data and clear answers on privacy.
Knowing the wider AI landscape helps when customers compare options.
